name: User story
about: A sprint-ready user story with acceptance criteria and task breakdown
title: "STORY-000: <short title> (<n> pts)"
labels: ["user story"]
---

**As a** <role>,
**I want** <goal>,
**so that** <reason this matters>.

**Estimate:** <n> story points · **Story owner:** <one name> · **Epic:** <epic>

### Acceptance criteria

<!-- Each one testable. Include at least one negative case. -->

1. **<name>** — *Given* <starting state>, *when* <action>, *then* <observable outcome>.
2. **<name>** — *Given* ..., *when* ..., *then* ...
3. **<name>** — *Given* ..., *when* ..., *then* ...

### Tasks

<!-- Each task ≤ 1 day, one named owner, an hour estimate. -->

- [ ] T-000.1 <task> — <owner> — <n> h
- [ ] T-000.2 <task> — <owner> — <n> h

### Definition of Ready

- [ ] Role / goal / reason all present
- [ ] Acceptance criteria written as Given / When / Then
- [ ] Broken into tasks of ≤ 1 day each
- [ ] Every task has an hour estimate and exactly one named owner
- [ ] Story has a point estimate agreed in planning
- [ ] No unresolved blocking dependency
